_doc: The game's sounds (Creel's game/audio: sounds_load). Each is assets/audio/sfx/<name>_<take>.wav, takes played in turn; gap: seconds it won't play again within; bus: a volume in dB over it (buses). Made by sound/flintlock.py, sound/wolves.py, sound/bear.py, sound/forest.py (the forest's beds and bird calls: 'forest' below) and sound/men.py (the men's feet, their work, an order's answer). The music is apart: data/music.json.

forest._doc: The forest's own sound (src/smyana/ambience.lobster, D-147; made by sound/forest.py). 'beds' are loops (assets/audio/sfx/amb_<name>_1.wav), each with its own level in dB under the Forest bus, faded up and down over 'fade_s' seconds by what is on the screen: the wind always, more in rain, snow and winter; small birds by day, most in spring, hardly any in winter; crickets on summer and early autumn nights; rain with the rain; the stream within 'stream_tiles' of water in view; the fire within 'fire_tiles' of a lit one. 'calls' is the bird heard now and then by day in each season (an owl at night), one every 'call_s' (from, to) seconds. The men's feet are beds too (D-148; sound/men.py): leaves, or snow where it lies, or wading in a ford, as loud as the men walking in view up to 'steps_men' of them.
